summary: TOOL-1 Login with valid and invalid credentials
description:
As a customer, I want to sign in so I can access my account.

* Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
* Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
* Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.
* Password field masks the input.

criteria.text: Valid email and password: the user is redirected to the account page and the user's name shows in the navigation.
Wrong password: an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
Empty fields: each empty field shows a required-field validation message.
The password field masks the input.

cases.title: Sign in with valid email and password
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email, a known correct password, and a name stored on the account. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
Enter the correct password in the password field.
cases.expected: The user is redirected to the account page, and the user's name is displayed in the navigation.

cases.title: Sign in with a valid email and a wrong password
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email and known correct password. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
Enter a password that is not the account's password in the password field.
cases.expected: An error message appears and the user remains on the login page (the exact message text is not specified in the story). The user is not redirected to the account page.

cases.title: Submit the login form with both fields empty
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in; both the email and password fields are empty.
cases.expected: Both the email field and the password field show a required-field validation message (the exact message text is not specified in the story). The user is not signed in.

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the email filled in
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known email. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the registered email in the email field.
cases.expected: The password field shows a required-field validation message (the exact message text is not specified in the story). The user is not signed in.

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the password filled in
cases.preconditions: A registered customer account exists with a known password. The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter a password in the password field.
cases.expected: The email field shows a required-field validation message (the exact message text is not specified in the story). The user is not signed in.

cases.title: Password field masks the typed characters
cases.preconditions: The tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Look at the characters shown in the password field.
cases.expected: The typed characters are masked and the entered password is not shown as readable text.
